canonical_project: Murzuq Municipal Data Center / Governance Data Hub (hosted at Fezzan University)
owner: UNDP Libya, Murzuq Municipality, Fezzan University
notes: UNDP RFQ UNDP-LBY-00644 (published 17-May-2026) states the Murzuq municipal data center hosted at Fezzan University was suspended due to funding gaps and withdrawal of previous international support; this phase revitalizes and completes the center and transitions it into a comprehensive governance hub with Statistics Bureau and Ministry of Social Affairs integration. Procurement evidence (A); facility is university/municipal institutional, not commercial colocation. Capacity not disclosed.
